offer.say: Desmond Faulk, music, Millbrook High. Eleven students, one sousaphone from 1971, and a dream. The dream is Section See. A pep band. In Section See. You see it? They see it. Everyone will see it. I'm sorry. I'm not sorry.

options.text: A band in Section See. I'm in.
Why do they want to play at hockey?
Does the sousaphone fit in the seats?
A band at hockey sounds loud.

why.say: Because nobody comes to the spring concert, but six hundred people come to a Lumber Kings game, and a hundred and fifty come to a Mallards game, and a hundred and fifty is the most people my kids have ever played for. They practise harder for the hundred and fifty.

options.text: Then they'll have their hundred and fifty.

sousa.say: Not in the roped-off ones. The broken seats in Section C are roped off with what I think is a Lumber Kings scarf. The sousaphone needs two seats and a prayer.

decline.say: It is loud. That's the point of a pep band. But I understand. We'll keep playing to the empty auditorium. The auditorium is very supportive.

accepted.say: Wonderful. The students have already written a fight song. It rhymes 'Mallards' with 'collards'. I'm workshopping it.

options.text: Going to look at the section.
Seats are done. About the letter.

p_letter.say: The letter! Yes. What goes on the end of the row?

options.text: Paint the C back on. Proper and tidy.
Leave the gap. Everybody knows it's Section See.

p_c.say: A C. Tidy. Correct. The students will be disappointed. Correct things disappoint teenagers.

p_gap.say: The gap. The gap is a tradition. Traditions are just gaps people love.

p_see.say: SEE! On the row! The students are going to lose their minds. I'm going to lose my mind. I'm going to write a march called Section See.

p_game.say: The fight song is finalised. Mallards rhymes with 'ballads' now. Better. Not good. Better.

complete.say: A hundred and sixty-two people. The kids counted. They played the fight song after every Mallards goal and twice after the other team's by mistake. The sousaphone survived. I may not have.

options.text: They were great. Come every home game.
Maybe a little quieter during the anthem.
Can they play a Lumber Kings game?

c_every.say: Every home game. They'll be insufferable. I'll be insufferable. Thank you.

c_quiet.say: The fryer's louder during the anthem. The sign says so. But yes. Quieter. We'll hum.

c_kings.say: Six hundred people. With Doreen's organ. I'd have to call Doreen. I'm frightened of Doreen. I'll call her.

done.say: Section See, home of the band.
